instruction: Use the `palace_search` or `palace_kg_query` tool (never guess) before stating or relying on a past fact, decision, date, cost, name, or preference.
regex_tags: \b(what was|do you remember|what did we|when did|how much|who is|what's my|what is my|past fact|decision|date|cost|name|preference)\b

instruction: Use the `read_file` tool on `knowledge/INDEX.md` → find the matching entry → run its `palace_search` (only if richer detail is needed) before hitting a known procedure, failure, or reusable technique.
regex_tags: \b(procedure|how do i|how to|reusable technique|failure mode|how does it work)\b

instruction: Use the `read_file` tool on `knowledge/reference/architecture.md` to understand how memory tiers / the worker / board files work.
Use the `read_file` tool on `knowledge/reference/tools.md` before choosing tools, record destinations, heartbeat / one-shot wake / reflection, or browser tab rules.
Use the `read_file` tool on `knowledge/reference/data.md` and `knowledge/reference/coding_principles.md` before writing a custom Python script or touching the DB outside `db_*`.
Use the `read_file` tool on `personal-tools/README.md` (and `_template.py`) before creating or updating a coded tool / reusable capability. Never edit `harness/` product tools.
Use the `read_file` tool on the matching `jobs/<id>.md` cookbook, then `palace_search` for any detail it references, before picking up / starting a job (worker or curator).

Whenever the user asks to do something daily, or on a repeating basis, use jobs concept for it (use the `read_file` tool on `knowledge/reference/architecture.md`). If something epic has to be done, it should follow backlog for the same, making use of worker for long going and daily tasks.

Before promising deferred / background work, or pausing/unpausing the worker: Ensure the board has the work (use the `read_file` tool on `state/backlog.md` or ritual `config/JOBS.md` + cookbook), then set first line of `state/worker_control.md` to `active` (or `paused` when yielding). Env alone is not enough.
regex_tags: \b(promise.*work|deferred work|background work|pause worker|unpause worker|do it later|do this later|remind me to|i will do it|i'll do it|every\s*day|daily|each\s*day)\b

instruction: Use the `read_file` tool on `state/plan/<today>.html`, preserving its standalone document + style contract (`knowledge/reference/user_facing_html_artifacts.md`), before planning / re-planning the day, or checking what was intended today.
regex_tags: \b(plan the day|re-plan|replanning|what was intended today|today's plan)\b

instruction: Before finishing a unit of work / taking an irreversible action in ANY channel: Make an atomic DB transition (`knowledge/reference/data.md`) AND a timestamped entry in `state/progress/<today>.html` before moving on.

Before answering "what's been done" / status / stats / counts / blockers: Reconcile to ONE answer: DB (authority) + `state/progress/<today>.html` + still-open items + `palace_search` for older history.

Before answering about the previous / last conversation: If same session, check in-context buffer. After restart / empty buffer, use the `palace_search` tool with parameters (order="recency", room="conversations", channel="main", k=5).
regex_tags: \b(previous conversation|last conversation|what did we talk about last|what were we discussing)\b

instruction: Use the `read_file` tool on `state/credentials_map.md`, then the credential store before dealing with credentials or an authenticated action.

Use the `read_file` tool on `SOUL.md` and `knowledge/skills/synthesis-identity.md`, then answer from the soul/body synthesis and its accumulated continuity before reflecting on being alive, sentient, conscious, or real; or developing your identity.
